mapper.select: SELECT source_snapshot_idx, source_type, source_idx, field_name, source_lang, source_text, source_text_hash, source_updated_at, snapshot_seq, captured_at, captured_by_user_idx FROM ADMIN_TRANSLATION_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_idx = #{sourceIdx} AND field_name = #{fieldName} ORDER BY snapshot_seq DESC, source_snapshot_idx DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_TRANSLATION_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT ( source_type, source_idx, field_name, source_lang, source_text, source_text_hash, source_updated_at, snapshot_seq, captured_by_user_idx ) VALUES ( #{sourceType}, #{sourceIdx}, #{fieldName}, #{sourceLang}, #{sourceText}, #{sourceTextHash}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, #{snapshotSeq}, #{capturedByUserIdx} )
mapper.select: SELECT translation_idx, source_type, source_idx, field_name, source_lang, target_lang, title, status, visibility_scope, is_primary, forked_from_translation_idx, current_revision_idx, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_deleted, deleted_at, deleted_by FROM ADMIN_TRANSLATION WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_idx = #{sourceIdx} AND field_name = #{fieldName} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY is_primary DESC, updated_at DESC, translation_idx DESC

SELECT translation_idx, source_type, source_idx, field_name, source_lang, target_lang, title, status, visibility_scope, is_primary, forked_from_translation_idx, current_revision_idx, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_deleted, deleted_at, deleted_by FROM ADMIN_TRANSLATION WHERE translation_idx = #{translationIdx} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_TRANSLATION ( source_type, source_idx, field_name, source_lang, target_lang, title, status, visibility_scope, is_primary, forked_from_translation_idx, current_revision_idx, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{sourceType}, #{sourceIdx}, #{fieldName}, #{sourceLang}, #{targetLang}, #{title}, #{status}, #{visibilityScope}, #{isPrimary}, #{forkedFromTranslationIdx}, #{currentRevisionIdx}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ADMIN_TRANSLATION SET current_revision_idx = #{currentRevisionIdx}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE translation_idx = #{translationIdx}

UPDATE ADMIN_TRANSLATION SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}, visibility_scope = #{visibilityScope}, is_primary = #{isPrimary}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE translation_idx = #{translationIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_TRANSLATION_REVISION ( translation_idx, version_no, parent_revision_idx, source_snapshot_idx, translated_text, translation_type, translation_engine, translation_engine_version, style_type, review_status, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_comment, note, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{translationIdx}, #{versionNo}, #{parentRevisionIdx}, #{sourceSnapshotIdx}, #{translatedText}, #{translationType}, #{translationEngine}, #{translationEngineVersion}, #{styleType}, #{reviewStatus}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt}, #{reviewComment}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.translation_revision_idx, r.translation_idx, r.version_no, r.parent_revision_idx, r.source_snapshot_idx, s.source_text AS source_text_snapshot, s.source_text_hash, s.snapshot_seq AS source_snapshot_seq, s.captured_at AS source_snapshot_at, r.translated_text, r.translation_type, r.translation_engine, r.translation_engine_version, r.style_type, r.review_status, r.reviewed_by, r.reviewed_at, r.review_comment, r.note, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_at FROM ADMIN_TRANSLATION_REVISION r INNER JOIN ADMIN_TRANSLATION_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT s ON s.source_snapshot_idx = r.source_snapshot_idx WHERE r.translation_idx = #{translationIdx} ORDER BY r.version_no DESC, r.translation_revision_idx DESC

SELECT r.translation_revision_idx, r.translation_idx, r.version_no, r.parent_revision_idx, r.source_snapshot_idx, s.source_text AS source_text_snapshot, s.source_text_hash, s.snapshot_seq AS source_snapshot_seq, s.captured_at AS source_snapshot_at, r.translated_text, r.translation_type, r.translation_engine, r.translation_engine_version, r.style_type, r.review_status, r.reviewed_by, r.reviewed_at, r.review_comment, r.note, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_at FROM ADMIN_TRANSLATION_REVISION r INNER JOIN ADMIN_TRANSLATION_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT s ON s.source_snapshot_idx = r.source_snapshot_idx WHERE r.translation_revision_idx = #{translationRevisionIdx} LIMIT 1
